sloka: ततो हि दुर्मना रामः श्रुत्वैवं वदतां गिरः ।दध्यौ मुहूर्तं धर्मात्मा बाष्पव्याकुललोचनः ।। ६.१२०.१ ।।
transliteration: tato hi durmanā rāmaḥ śrutvaivaṁ vadatāṁ giraḥ ।dadhyau muhūrtaṁ dharmātmā bāṣpavyākulalocanaḥ ।। 6.120.1 ।।

translations.english: Then righteous Rama, hearing the wailing of the people, whose eyes were dimmed with tears, remained for a moment.
